package nats

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strconv"
	"sync"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

// OutboxPublisher publishes acknowledged Student outbox events over JetStream.
type OutboxPublisher struct {
	Conn *natsgo.Conn

	mu sync.Mutex
	js natsgo.JetStreamContext
}

func (publisher *OutboxPublisher) Publish(ctx context.Context, event domain.IntegrationEvent) error {
	if publisher == nil || publisher.Conn == nil || (event.Subject != domain.SubjectLearningActionClosed && event.Subject != domain.SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted && event.Subject != domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged) ||
		event.EventID == "" || !json.Valid(event.Payload) {
		return errors.New("invalid student outbox event")
	}
	if event.Subject == domain.SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted {
		if err := domain.ValidateDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(event); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if event.Subject == domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged {
		if err := domain.ValidatePlanningStateChangedEvent(event); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	jetStream, err := publisher.jetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	message := natsgo.NewMsg(event.Subject)
	message.Data = event.Payload
	message.Header.Set(natsgo.MsgIdHdr, event.EventID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Event-ID", event.EventID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Correlation-ID", event.CorrelationID)
	if event.CausationID != "" {
		message.Header.Set("X-Causation-ID", event.CausationID)
	}
	message.Header.Set("X-Schema-Version", strconv.Itoa(event.SchemaVersion))
	_, err = jetStream.PublishMsg(message, natsgo.Context(ctx))
	return err
}

func (publisher *OutboxPublisher) jetStream() (natsgo.JetStreamContext, error) {
	publisher.mu.Lock()
	defer publisher.mu.Unlock()
	if publisher.js != nil {
		return publisher.js, nil
	}
	jetStream, err := publisher.Conn.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	publisher.js = jetStream
	return publisher.js, nil
}

var _ domain.DurableEventPublisher = (*OutboxPublisher)(nil)
